  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  MIT BLR - BTech VI Semester - End Semester Examination - April / May -2025  
  Introduction to Internet of Things [NPT-3202]  
  Marks: 50                                                                             Duration: 180 mins.  
  PART-A  
  Answer all the questions.  
  1)           A family installs an IoT-based smart home system that includes smart lighting, security  
  cameras, voice-controlled assistants, and automated climate control. The system collects  
  and processes real-time data to enhance convenience and security. Explain the main       (5)  
  A)      components involved in development of such IoT environment? Provide examples.  
  
  B)      A large-scale smart farm is integrating IoT-based automation to optimize crop  
  production. The farm grows vegetables and fruits that require precise monitoring of soil  
  moisture, temperature, humidity, and sunlight exposure. To improve efficiency, the farm (5)  
  deploys a network of sensors and actuators that work together to ensure optimal growing  
  conditions. Explain the role of sensors and actuators in this IoT system.  
  
  2)           Develop an Arduino Program to read input from a push button and turn on an LED when  
  pressed.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      Write a sketch that reads temperature data from a DHT11 sensor and displays it on the  
  Serial Monitor                                                                             (5)  
  
  3)           Identify the differences between short-range and long-range IoT communication  
  protocols.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      A large manufacturing company is implementing an Industrial IoT (IIoT) system to  
  automate its smart factory. The factory has thousands of IoT devices, including robotic  
  arms, conveyor belt sensors, temperature monitors, and quality control cameras. These      (5)  
  devices need to communicate efficiently with each other and with a central control  
  system. Explain how AMQP is used in establishing this environment?  
  
  4)           How does a Sensor Cloud integrate with IoT systems?  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      A city government is implementing a smart traffic management system using IoT              (5)  
  sensors and cameras to reduce congestion. However, sending all data to the cloud  
  introduces delays. How can fog computing help improve real-time decision-making in
